'''Danel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was a member of the [[Crystal Wasters]], a group of surfers that were based on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Dorumaa's Children]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Danel began working for the organization of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rufus Trammel]].

==Behind the scenes==
Danel was created by [[Rob Edwards]] and was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure ''[[Dorumaa's Children]]''. In the adventure, the character's name is spelt as both "Danel" and "Denal." This article spells his name as "Danel," because that is the spelling that is used most frequently in the scenario.
